verdict.rationale: Smooth is a browser-automation API and CLI, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The evidence documents running, listing and cancelling tasks and sessions, but nothing on saved automation definitions, version history, review/diff, or rollback. Task listing and cancellation are adjacent features, and keeping task code in the user's own source control would be a user-side workaround; neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
